ui.common.backend_startup.title_starting.tone: Plain fact about the app's own server, then one concrete step; never blame the user.
ui.common.backend_startup.title_starting.note: Shown in backend-startup-panel.tsx, the app-level band that replaces the connectivity banner while the owned server is starting or failed to start.

ui.common.backend_startup.detail_startin.tone: Plain fact about the app's own server, then one concrete step; never blame the user.
ui.common.backend_startup.detail_startin.note: Shown in backend-startup-panel.tsx, the app-level band that replaces the connectivity banner while the owned server is starting or failed to start. Shown on every start, including after Restart, so it must not say 'first'.

placeholders.seconds: whole number of seconds in the server's readiness budget (READINESS_BUDGET_MS, 30 today); plural arms follow the locale's CLDR categories, # is the number
